title: Room: entities, DAOs, migrations, and queries that return a Flow

videos.script: Today the planner stops forgetting. Its sessions go into a database on the phone, and stay there. {{room}} Every Android phone has SQLite. Room sits on top of it and reads your SQL while the app compiles. {{entities}} First, entities: a class that is a table. A course, a session, and the key that ties one to the other. {{converters}} Then a date, which SQLite has no type for. The build refuses it, and four lines fix that. {{daos}} Then the queries. You will misspell a table on purpose and watch the build catch it, before any phone could. {{flow}} Then a query that never finishes. Each time the table changes, it answers again, and the week's total follows by itself. {{migrations}} And last, version two. A new column, on a database you will never see, on somebody else's phone. You will write the migration, and test it three ways: right, missing, and wrong.
